method: Same-person adjacent-month screen using WPFINWGT and 240 Census replicate weights with Fay BRR, perturbation factor 0.5; earnings and hours retain separate valid-pair universes.
result: The refresh reproduces the promoted point estimates and intervals in us-sipp-utility-work-following-2024.json. No new trend record is created.
boundary: This is a reproduction audit, not a causal estimate. The SIPP screen does not establish a dated utility shock, assistance effect, job loss, desired-hours mismatch, household prevalence, care substitution, recovery, trust, or political action. Primary and replicate files remain outside Git.
